verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm native window functions and first-class semi-structured/array SQL types (VARIANT/OBJECT/ARRAY), which is strong evidence for the analytic SQL surface without extensions. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation reference for CTEs or Snowflake's rich date/time type system, so the full breadth of the story isn't directly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit CTE support docs, explicit date/time type reference, independent hands-on corroboration of the full SQL surface.
